answer.answer: A single power-law slope can in principle be extrapolated across the 11-500 and 500-5000 um windows, but pump vs net sampling differ in captured area/volume and size-dependent efficiency, so the conversion is only approximate. Published slopes vary by site and polymer composition, so applying one 'usual' slope to convert between these two methods' counts is not reliably valid without site-specific calibration.
